notes.title: Ver. 2.0 Update Information
notes.content:
Content• Main Story Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Phase 1 is here!
The following content has been added alongside the release of the latest part of the Main Story.
[p align="start"]　Content added:
　┗4★ Phantom Thief Riko Tanemura, along with her exclusive weapons (including 5★)
　┗Palace
　┗Mementos
　┗City Life: Kichijoji
[p align="start"]　▽ Special Event to Commemorate the Release of Main Story Chapter 3!
　Duration: Until Oct 23, 2025 1:59 AM (UTC)
[p align="start"]
　Log in for 7 days during the event period to receive a total of Platinum Tickets x20 and Platinum Milicoins x20 from the event's Login Bonus.
　Plus, play the new content added in Main Story Chapter 3 and achieve the goals to earn rewards including Meta Jewels, Joy Medals, and a Riko Tanemura-exclusive 4★ weapon and the materials to max forge it.
[p align="start"]　*Please check the announcement that will be posted at a later date for more details.


• 5★ Phantom Thief: Ren Amamiya Makes a Comeback![p align="start"]Check out Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: The Phantom Magician as well as Arms Deals: Silent Pistol, featuring the Ren Amamiya-only 5★ weapon Phoenix Dagger in Most Wanted.
Duration: After the Sep 4 maintenance
*Please check the announcement that will be posted at a later date for more details.

• New Tasks Feature: Make Requests to Earn Items[p align="start"]Once your Player Level reaches 20, you'll be able to use the Tasks feature, where you can send eligible allies to complete Tasks and receive rewards after a set amount of time.
The required time and rewards vary depending on the request. Use this feature to get Meta Jewels, Thief's Cognitite Shards, and other items.
You can access this feature from the Tasks option on the in-game home screen.

　▽Gifts to Celebrate the Release of Tasks & Thief's Cognitite Shards![p align="start"]　Distribution dates and times: After the Sep 4, 2025 maintenance
　To commemorate the introduction of Tasks and new items, we will be giving away Thief's Cognitite Shards x60 and Task Refresh Ticket x10.
　Thief's Cognitite Shards can be exchanged for certain Phantom Thieves' Cognitite Shards, and each set of 60 shards can be traded for Cognitite, which is used to Awaken the Awareness of characters.
　As of the end of Sep 4, 2025 maintenance, selectable characters will include 5★ Phantom Thieves appearing in Phantom Idol Draft X as well as Ren Amamiya, Yui, and Minami Miyashita.
　Thief's Cognitite Shards can be found in-game via Menu > Bag > Consumables.
　*Check your in-game Mail for more details on this gift.

• New Protagonist Training Feature: Super Level Added[p align="start"]This new feature will allow you to strengthen and train the protagonist.
After reaching Player Level 80, any additional experience gained will increase your level with the notation "S-LV.", granting you new Schema Points that can be used to raise the protagonist's base stats.
Use these new Schema Points to increase the protagonist's HP, Attack, and Defense.
Access this feature by selecting the protagonist from the Phantom Thief menu in the in-game menu.

• Puzzle Event Begins![p align="start"]Duration: Until Sep 10, 2025 7:59 PM (UTC)
Complete daily missions to collect special items and complete the puzzle.
Earn rewards such as Meta Jewels, Platinum Tickets, and Platinum Milicoins based on your puzzle progress.
This content can be accessed from the in-game Events menu.
*Please check the announcement that will be posted at a later date for more details.
[p align="start"]

notes.title: Ver. 1.4 Update Information
notes.content:
Content• New Thief Training feature: Mindscape
This new feature will allow you to strengthen and train your Phantom Thieves, excluding the Protagonist.
You can use Mindscape from each Phantom Thief's training screen after reaching Player Rank 55.
Collect the Training Material: Stardust Shards to boost various stats.
Stardust Shards can be obtained daily based on the total number of stars earned in The Velvet Trials.

• Trial of Thorns Event[p align="start"]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Sep 4, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)
Take on powerful bosses in this high-difficulty event!
*More details will be provided in a future announcement.
• New Metro of Desire Route Unlocked[p align="start"]A new route has opened up, with up to 8 difficulty levels and its own special operations.
Additionally, new bosses, Special Effects, Charms, and lost items will be added, and the level cap for Route Goals will be raised to 150.
　Level cap raised to 130: After the maintenance on Aug 21, 2025 (Thu)
　Level cap raised to 150: On Aug 27, 2025 (Wed) at 8:00 PM (UTC)
Participants can receive a plethora of rewards including Gold Tickets and Training Materials, so don't miss out!
　Spin to Win Raffle event in the Metro of Desire
　Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Sep 4, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)
　Collect Route Tickets and try your luck in the raffle.
　Earn Route Tickets by completing Marthym's Limited-Time Offers, which are updated daily, or by playing Metro of Desire.
　Participate in the raffle to win rewards such as Platinum Tickets and Platinum Milicoins.
*Marthym's Limited-Time Offers will be available until 7:59 PM on Sep 3, 2025 (Wed) (UTC).
• Change in Phantom Pass duration[p align="start"]Current: From Aug 6, 2025 (Wed) 8:00 PM until 1:59 AM on Sep 18, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)
After the Aug 21, 2025 maintenance: From Aug 6, 2025 (Wed) 8:00 PM until 1:59 AM on Sep 22, 2025 (Mon) (UTC)
• Login Bonus[p align="start"]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Sep 4, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)
During the event period, log in for 7 days to get 7 Platinum Ticket!

notes.title: Ver. 1.1 Update Information
notes.content:
Content
・Main Story: Up to end of Chapter 2 unlocked

・New Content: Metro of Desire
Board a train and take down the Boss Shadow at the heart of the Control Center!

Along the way, you’ll encounter a variety of events, including battles against Shadows and meetings with new people.

To gain the upper hand in the Control Center, you can perform Train Upgrades and enhance yourself and your party with Lost Items obtainable as you play through the level.

You can also earn a wealth of rewards by achieving Route Goals and performing Special Ops as you advance.
　▽Spin to Win Raffle event happening now in the Metro of Desire!
　　Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jul 24, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)

　　Earn Route Tickets by completing the daily-updated Marthym's Limited-Time Offers or playing Metro of Desire, then trade them for spins!

　　Rewards include Platinum Tickets, Platinum Milicoins, Gold Tickets, and more!

・Login Bonus
Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jul 24, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)

During the event period, log in for 7 days to get 7 Platinum Milicoins!

・Addition of Lufel's "Business" Plan III & IV
Complete Lufel's "Business" Plan III to get a 5★ Cognitite Case, which lets you select a 5★ Phantom Thief's Cognitite of your choice.

Complete Lufel's "Business" Plan IV to get a 5★ Weapon Case, which lets you select a 5★ weapon of your choice.

・New additions to the Clear Cognigem Exchange Shop
Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jul 24, 2025 (Thu) (UTC)

During the event period, training materials, Revelation Cards, and more have been added to the Clear Cognigem tab at the Exchange Shop!

Get the hard-to-find Growth Revelation - Purple and Faith Revelation - Purple, too!

・Synergy Unlocks
　▽Check it out!

　└(New) Shun Kano

　└(Added) Yui, Yaoling Li, Motoha Arai, Tomoko Noge, Kayo Tomiyama, Merope

・Side Mission Unlocks
　▽Check it out!

・City Life Updates
　▽Check it out!

　└Shinjuku bookstore part-time job, Band club practice, Soccer practice

・Follow feature for Official Social Media Accounts
Get a Gold Ticket for each social media account you follow under "Follow our official accounts!!" in Events.

・More detail has been added to the skill descriptions of some Phantom Thieves.
　(There is no change to the skills themselves.)

　Check in-game for more details.
